QUOTE: "It is never retried automatically." and "`ClientPosts.createPost` passes `noRetry: true` ... which sets `retryLimit: 0`... So a failed send is not retried at the network layer either."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the create-post request is never retried automatically (zero retries, noRetry), and that each manual attempt makes a single send.
